questions.solution:
def transpose(matrix):
    rows = len(matrix)
    cols = len(matrix[0])
    result = [[matrix[j][i] for j in range(rows)] for i in range(cols)]
    return result

for row in transpose([[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]]):
    print(row)
